papers.abstract: General-purpose coding agents can now write, debug, and refine entire robot programs, but only if they have somewhere to practice. Physical hardware is a poor practice ground: exploratory rollouts are slow to reset and, when several arms share a workspace, unsafe. Generic simulation benchmarks are safe but do not match the geometry, assets, or viewpoints of the workspace where the robot must actually work. We present CoEx (Code-driven Exploration), which lets the agent practice in an executable digital twin of its own deployment workspace. The twin is built by CoEnv, our real-to-sim framework, which reconstructs the physical scene from multi-view RGBD into a physics simulation. Inside it, a centralized code agent explores at the program level, writing a complete multi-arm program, running it in the twin, and refining it against grounded verification (privileged state checks, checkpoint predicates on risky steps, and adaptive viewpoints against inter-arm occlusion). Verified programs transfer to hardware through collision-checked deployment. On five real-world multi-arm tasks with up to three heterogeneous robots, CoEx reaches 70% average success, against 50% for the same system without the code agent (where a VLM must choose every primitive step by step), outperforms two prior VLM-planning frameworks, and produces verified episodes at 3.8-11.7x the ablated rate. Because every verified rollout is also a demonstration, exploration leaves reusable experience behind: a $\pi_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned purely on 200 agent-generated rollouts reaches 100% and 70% real-robot success on two tasks, with no human demonstrations.

analysis.key_results: 在五个真实世界多臂任务（最多三台异构机器人）上，CoEx 平均成功率达 70%，而消融系统为 50%；超越两个先前 VLM 规划框架；验证部署的成功率是消融的 3.8-11.7 倍；利用 200 条智能体生成的演示微调 π0.5 策略，在两个任务上分别达到 100% 和 70% 的真实机器人成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CoEx（代码驱动探索）与 CoEnv（实数到仿真框架），使编码智能体在自身工作空间的数字孪生中通过编写、调试和优化程序来完成多臂操作任务，并实现安全、可验证的物理部署。
analysis.method: CoEnv 从多视角 RGBD 重建物理场景为物理仿真环境；中心化代码智能体在此数字孪生中编写完整多臂程序、运行并通过特权状态检查、风险步骤检查点及自适应视角进行验证；验证后的程序经碰撞检查部署到实际硬件。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoEnv 通过代码驱动的探索在真实到仿真的数字孪生中训练多臂机器人操控，实现从虚拟验证到实际部署的高效迁移。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作通过真实到仿真的数字孪生和代码级探索生成高质量演示数据，进而微调 VLA 类策略（π0.5），证明了仿真探索经验对提升视觉-语言-动作模型的实用性，与 VLA 的数据生成和技能学习直接相关。

(a) co-training mixes simulated trajectories into the training set alongside a few real ones, and (b) sim RL optimizes a policy π θ \pi_{\theta} against simulated rollouts and a reward. papers.abstract: A fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy can easily place the alphabet soup in the basket on command, just as it saw during fine-tuning. However, if the basket is shifted five centimeters to the left, it drops the soup off the table. We developed an interpretability pipeline to investigate what such a policy is computing. Injecting task A's activations into the action expert while the policy looks at task B's scene makes $\pi_{0.5}$ execute task A's motor trajectory in 99.6\% of episodes ($n{=}1{,}968$). The injected program is bound to absolute workspace coordinates and ignores the visible scene, which provides a mechanistic account of the perturbation brittleness that concurrent benchmarks report. The binding holds on a physical UR10e: directed replay redirects the commanded task in 26/26 rollouts in one direction and 18/26 in the other, with no-injection and random-direction controls at the floor, and once the source object is moved 10-15 cm the arm grasps and releases at the recorded coordinates in 50/50 trials, picking up the wrong block when one sits there and closing on empty air when none does. Applying the same interventions to five VLAs on LIBERO, MetaWorld, SimplerEnv, and ALOHA over $420{,}000+$ rollouts yields three further findings: every architecture encodes the instruction, and four of the five weight it below vision whenever the scene alone identifies the goal; under the standard replacement write-back the SAE pooling that preserves behavior is architecture-specific ($\pi_{0.5}$ per-token, SmolVLA indifferent), and goal selection and motor generation separate into VLM and expert pathways wherever the two are distinguishable. We release \textbf{Action Atlas} (https://action-atlas.com), an interactive platform covering all 520+ trained SAEs, 79 identified concepts, and the scored UR10e rollouts. Code: https://cwru-aism.github.io/vla-interp-page/

analysis.key_results: 注入任务A的激活可使π0.5在99.6%的回合中执行任务A的动作轨迹；动作程序绑定到绝对工作空间坐标而非可见场景；在五个VLA模型上验证发现四个模型在场景能识别目标时对指令的权重低于视觉；目标选择与运动生成在可区分处分离到VLM和专家路径。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个可解释性流水线，通过激活注入定位并分析了VLA策略中与任务指令和动作生成相关的内部表征，并发布了交互式平台Action Atlas。
analysis.method: 采用激活注入等干预手段，分析VLA模型内部表征，并结合多个基准（LIBERO、MetaWorld、SimplerEnv、ALOHA）和真实机器人（UR10e）进行大规模验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过可解释性干预实验揭示了微调后的视觉-语言-动作模型在扰动场景下表现脆弱的机制原因：模型可能依赖绝对工作空间坐标而非视觉场景来生成动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接以视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为对象，通过机制可解释性分析揭示其内部表征和脆弱性根源，对VLA的鲁棒性和世界模型建模具有重要参考价值。

papers.abstract: Deploying artificial intelligence at the edge is increasingly important for systems that must operate under strict limits on memory, computation, energy, connectivity, and hardware cost. Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) represents the most resource-constrained regime of this shift, enabling inference on microcontroller-class devices with tightly bounded flash and SRAM budgets. This study examines recent deployment trends in Edge AI and TinyML using precision farming as a representative real-world environment in which sensing nodes, gateways, UAVs, and embedded processors must often operate with intermittent connectivity and limited power. The analysis emphasizes the deployment stack rather than predictive accuracy alone, covering hardware classes, software toolchains, model- and system-level optimization, intelligence placement, and hardware-resource reporting. Across the analyzed studies, microcontroller-class platforms such as ESP32, STM32, and ATmega are prominent endpoint targets, while single-board computers and embedded accelerators support more compute-intensive workloads. Among the studies included in the optimization comparison, almost 50% report quantization, making reduced-precision inference the most frequently identified strategy within this subset. In contrast, structured pruning, hardware-aware neural architecture search, and coordinated cross-layer optimization remain comparatively limited. Resource profiling is also inconsistent as flash, peak RAM, MAC count, latency, and energy per inference are not reported uniformly, limiting reproducibility and comparisons across deployments. A recurring systems-level pattern is an inference-training asymmetry in which inference moves toward local devices while training and model lifecycle management remain predominantly centralized.

analysis.key_results: 微控制器平台（ESP32、STM32、ATmega）是主要端点目标；在优化比较中，近50%的研究报告了量化；结构化剪枝、硬件感知神经架构搜索与跨层协调优化仍相对有限；资源分析（flash、峰值RAM、MAC数、延迟、每推理能耗）报告不一致；推理向本地设备迁移而训练与模型生命周期管理仍集中化。
analysis.main_contribution: 分析资源受限农业领域的Edge AI与TinyML部署趋势，覆盖硬件类别、软件工具链、模型与系统级优化、智能放置及硬件资源报告，并强调部署栈而非仅预测精度。
analysis.method: 对近期相关研究进行系统调研与比较，聚焦硬件平台、软件工具链、量化、剪枝、架构搜索等优化策略以及资源报告一致性方面的部署实践。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文调研了在资源受限农业场景中Edge AI与TinyML的硬件平台、部署工具链、模型优化与优化报告实践，突出量化作为最常见的精简推理策略。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown great promise as generalist policies for a large range of relatively simple tasks. However, they demonstrate limited performance on more complex tasks, such as those requiring complex spatial or semantic understanding, manipulation in clutter, or precise manipulation. We propose OmniGuide, a flexible framework that improves VLA performance on such tasks by leveraging arbitrary sources of guidance, such as 3D foundation models, semantic-reasoning VLMs, and human pose models. We show how many kinds of guidance can be naturally expressed as differentiable energy functions with task-specific attractors and repellers located in 3D space, that influence the sampling of VLA actions. In this way, OmniGuide enables guidance sources with complementary task-relevant strengths to improve a VLA model's performance on challenging tasks. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments, across diverse sources of guidance, demonstrate that OmniGuide enhances the performance of state-of-the-art generalist policies (e.g., $\pi_{0.5}$, GR00T N1.6) significantly across success and safety rates. Critically, our unified framework matches or surpasses the performance of prior methods designed to incorporate specific sources of guidance into VLA policies. Project page: https://omniguide.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在模拟和真实环境中的大量实验表明，OmniGuide显著提升了最先进通用策略（如π0.5、GR00T N1.6）的成功率和安全率；该统一框架匹配或超越了此前为特定引导源设计的专用方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OmniGuide，一个灵活的框架，利用任意来源的引导（如3D基础模型、语义推理VLM、人体姿态模型）作为可微能量函数，以任务特定的吸引子和排斥子影响VLA动作采样，从而提升VLA在复杂任务上的性能。
analysis.method: 将多种引导源表达为3D空间中的可微能量函数（包含任务特定的吸引子和排斥子），并利用这些能量函数影响VLA模型的行动采样过程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OmniGuide框架，通过将任意引导源表达为可微能量函数来影响VLA动作采样，从而提升复杂任务性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型，旨在提升其在复杂任务中的表现，属于本站核心主题。通过引入空间引导场改进动作生成，对VLA和机器人操作有直接贡献。

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in language-centric tasks. However, in agentic settings, LLMs often struggle to anticipate action consequences and adapt to environment dynamics, highlighting the need for world-modeling capabilities in LLM-based agents. We propose Reinforcement World Model Learning (RWML), a self-supervised method that learns action-conditioned world models for LLM-based agents on textual states using sim-to-real gap rewards. Our method aligns simulated next states produced by the model with realized next states observed from the environment, encouraging consistency between internal world simulations and actual environment dynamics in a pre-trained embedding space. Unlike next-state token prediction, which prioritizes token-level fidelity (i.e., reproducing exact wording) over semantic equivalence and can lead to model collapse, our method provides a more robust training signal and is empirically less susceptible to reward hacking than LLM-as-a-judge. We evaluate our method on ALFWorld and $\tau^2$ Bench and observe significant gains over the base model, despite using no expert data, task-success rewards, or strong-LLM annotations - only an off-the-shelf embedding model as a distance metric. When combined with task-success rewards, our method outperforms direct task-success reward RL by 6.9 and 5.7 points on ALFWorld and $\tau^2$ Bench respectively; it further outperforms expert-data training on ALFWorld and is comparable to it on $\tau^2$ Bench.

analysis.key_results: 在ALFWorld和τ² Bench上相比基座模型显著提升；与任务成功奖励结合时，分别超过直接任务成功奖励RL 6.9和5.7分；在ALFWorld上超过专家数据训练，在τ² Bench上与之相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RWML，一种自监督方法，利用模拟-真实差距奖励为LLM智能体学习动作条件世界模型，并在无专家数据、任务成功奖励或强LLM标注的情况下显著提升性能。
analysis.method: RWML使用自监督学习，通过模拟-真实差距奖励对齐模型生成的模拟下一状态与环境中观察到的真实下一状态，在预训练嵌入空间中鼓励内部世界模拟与实际环境动态的一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种自监督方法RWML，通过模拟-真实差距奖励为基于文本状态的LLM智能体学习动作条件世界模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型学习，专注于文本状态下LLM智能体的动作条件世界建模，与VLA/WAM主题具有相关性，但其环境为文本模拟而非机器人物理世界，未直接涉及机器人动作或视觉输入。

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance in long-horizon agentic tasks through multi-step interaction and reasoning at test time. However, repeatedly invoking these models incurs substantial inference cost over an episode. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost, but using a fixed low precision throughout an episode can sharply lower task success. We observe that interaction steps differ sharply in their sensitivity to quantization: given the same context, decoding a step at low precision turns a success into a failure at only about 1% of the steps, which we call critical steps. Based on this observation, we propose Dynamic Mixed-Precision Routing (DMR), a framework that adaptively selects between high-precision and low-precision versions of the same LLM at each decision step. Leveraging an entire-space factorization to jointly predict a step's divergence and its effect on the outcome, DMR learns to recognize these critical steps by training only a lightweight router on the model's hidden state. By reusing a shared high-precision KV cache and the hidden states, DMR avoids redundant context prefill and a separate text encoder, enabling precision switching with less than 1 ms of overhead per step and adding less than 0.11% to step latency for routing. This mixed-precision design also enables nested quantization, reducing the memory footprint by 39% on average compared with FP16. Across three long-horizon agentic benchmarks with nested quantization, DMR achieves an average 2.44x decode speedup over FP16 at comparable task success rates, without fine-tuning the underlying model. On ALFWorld with GPTQ, DMR achieves a 1.71x decode speedup with 86.9% success, compared with 87.2% for FP16.

analysis.key_results: 在三个长时程智能体基准上，嵌套量化下DMR相比FP16实现平均2.44倍解码加速；在ALFWorld上达到86.9%成功率，FP16为87.2%，解码加速1.71倍；路由开销小于1ms，占步骤延迟不到0.11%；内存占用平均降低39%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出动态混合精度路由（DMR）框架，通过轻量级路由器预测关键步骤，在保持任务成功率的同时实现混合精度切换，减少推理成本。
analysis.method: 利用全空间分解联合预测步骤发散性和结果影响，训练轻量路由器识别关键步骤；复用高精度KV缓存和隐藏状态避免冗余预填充和额外文本编码器，支持精度切换开销小于1ms；同时支持嵌套量化以降低内存占用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出动态混合精度路由框架DMR，在每个决策步骤自适应选择高/低精度LLM版本，以减少长时程智能体任务中的推理成本并保持任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM的量化推理效率，不直接涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界-动作模型（WAM）。但其提出的动态精度路由方法对于在机器人策略或世界模型中实施高效量化推理具有潜在借鉴价值，可作为量化技术在具身智能中应用的参考。

papers.abstract: Language-conditioned goal navigation requires embodied agents to locate user-specified targets without step-by-step guidance. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on category-level goals or rely on instance descriptions generated by vision-language models, which often contain ambiguities and semantic errors, limiting systematic and reliable evaluation. We introduce HieraNav, an open-vocabulary navigation task with goals at four hierarchical semantic levels: scene, room, region, and instance. We present Language as a Map (LangMap), the first goal navigation benchmark to enrich real-world indoor 3D scans with human-verified semantic annotations supporting tasks across all four goal levels. Built on HM3D using a contrastive annotation protocol that compares same-scene regions and instances, LangMap provides region labels and discriminative region and instance descriptions covering 414 object categories and contains over 18K tasks. Each target has concise and detailed descriptions, enabling evaluation across instruction styles. Automated and human evaluations validate our annotation quality: our descriptions improve text-to-view matching accuracy over GOAT-Bench's by 23 points on all shared annotated instances, and an independent human audit yields 92.5% unique-and-correct matches. We also propose PlaNaVid, an RGB-only baseline that combines Bounded Diverse Memory with high-level planning to prime a reactive policy for multi-goal navigation, achieving top-tier success rates without depth, 3D scene representations, or object masks. Further analyses reveal that exploration and hierarchical disambiguation failures become more prominent at finer goal levels, while long-tail categories, small objects, distant targets, timely stopping, and multi-goal completion remain challenging. Benchmark and code: https://bo-miao.github.io/LangMap

papers.abstract: The advent of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) offers a promising technology to tackle the limitations of modular design in autonomous driving, which often falters in open-world scenarios requiring sustained environmental understanding and logical reasoning. Besides, embodied artificial intelligence facilitates policy optimization through closed-loop interactions to achieve the continuous learning capability, thereby advancing autonomous driving toward embodied intelligent (EI) driving. However, such capability will be constrained by relying solely on LMMs to enhance EI driving without joint decision-making. This article proposes a novel semantics and policy dual-driven hybrid decision framework to tackle this challenge, ensuring continuous learning and joint decision. The framework merges LMMs for semantic understanding and cognitive representation, and deep reinforcement learning for real-time policy optimization. This article particularly details the foundational principles of EI driving and LMMs, and also introduces the emerging opportunities this framework enables, encompassing potential benefits and representative use cases. The proposed framework, evaluated through a lane-change planning case study, achieves at least a 19% performance improvement over the baselines, as verified by simulations. Finally, key open challenges and future research directions are identified to guide subsequent work.

analysis.key_results: 在换道规划案例研究中，通过仿真验证，该框架相比基线取得了至少19%的性能提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种语义与策略双驱动的混合决策框架，将大型多模态模型与深度强化学习结合，实现具身智能驾驶中的持续学习和联合决策。
analysis.method: 结合大型多模态模型进行语义理解和认知表征，并利用深度强化学习进行实时策略优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种融合大型多模态模型语义理解与深度强化学习实时策略优化的混合决策框架，推动自主驾驶向具身智能驾驶发展。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a unified paradigm for robotic perception and control, enabling emergent generalization and long-horizon task execution. However, their deployment in dynamic, real-world environments is severely hindered by high inference latency. While smooth robotic interaction requires control frequencies of 20-30 Hz, current VLA models typically operate at only 3-5 Hz on edge devices due to the memory-bound nature of autoregressive decoding. Existing optimizations often require extensive retraining or compromise model accuracy. To bridge this gap, we introduce ActionFlow, a system-level inference framework tailored for resource-constrained edge platforms. At the core of ActionFlow is a Cross-Request Pipelining strategy, a novel scheduler that redefines VLA inference as a macro-pipeline of micro-requests. The strategy intelligently batches memory-bound Decode phases with compute-bound Prefill phases across continuous time steps to maximize hardware utilization. Furthermore, to support this scheduling, we propose a Cross-Request State Packed Forward operator and a Unified KV Ring Buffer, which fuse fragmented memory operations into efficient dense computations. Experimental results demonstrate that ActionFlow achieves a 2.55x improvement in FPS on the OpenVLA-7B model without retraining, enabling real-time dynamic manipulation on edge hardware. Our work is available at https://github.com/Frankd35/Action-Flow.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVLA-7B模型上无需重训练，FPS提升2.55倍，能在边缘硬件上实现实时动态操作。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了ActionFlow，一个专为VLA模型设计的边缘端推理加速框架，核心贡献包括跨请求流水线调度策略及配套的高效算子与内存管理组件。
analysis.method: Cross-Request Pipelining 将VLA推理重构为微请求宏流水线，智能混合Decode与Prefill阶段；Cross-Request State Packed Forward算子融合内存碎片操作；Unified KV Ring Buffer统一管理KV缓存。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ActionFlow是一个面向资源受限边缘平台的系统级推理框架，通过跨请求流水线在不重训练的情况下将VLA模型推理速度提升2.55倍，实现实时动态操作。

papers.abstract: Tensor-train (TT) compression reduces neural-network parameters, but the latency of a tensorized layer is set by its contraction order and its mapping onto hardware: a contraction path with fewer multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) is not necessarily faster on a systolic array. We present a deployment-constrained, latency-guided design space exploration (DSE) framework for fixed-rank tensorized neural networks (TNNs) under a fixed processing-element (PE) budget. Using MAC-guided path pruning, it evaluates feasible combinations of contraction paths, three PE-array partitions, and input-, output-, and weight-stationary dataflows. By minimizing the sum of inference and training latency estimates, it selects a single physical PE partition shared across layers and both modes, while allowing layer- and mode-specific paths and dataflows. On ResNet-18 and ViT-Ti/4, 25%-50% of the layers select a path other than the minimum-MAC one, the best dataflow varies across layers and models, and on a representative ViT layer the latency-selected candidate reduces simulated latency by 23.5% relative to the minimum-MAC candidate. Deployed on a Xilinx VU9P FPGA accelerator that supports both inference and training, the complete TT+INT8 system achieves 3.28x-4.00x inference and 3.42x-3.85x training speedups over dense implementations with the same PE budget.

analysis.key_results: 在ResNet-18和ViT-Ti/4上，25%-50%的层选择了非最小MAC路径；代表性ViT层的延迟选择候选比最小MAC候选降低23.5%的模拟延迟；在Xilinx VU9P FPGA上，完整的TT+INT8系统相比同PE预算的密集实现，推理加速3.28-4.00倍，训练加速3.42-3.85倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个部署约束、延迟引导的设计空间探索框架，用于在固定PE预算下为固定秩张量化神经网络优化收缩路径、PE阵列划分和数据流，以最小化推理与训练延迟。
analysis.method: 使用MAC引导的路径剪枝，评估可行的收缩路径、三种PE阵列划分以及输入、输出和权重静态数据流组合，选择跨层和模式共享的物理PE划分，同时允许层和模式特定的路径与数据流。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种部署约束、延迟引导的设计空间探索框架，用于在固定PE预算下为固定秩张量化神经网络选择最优收缩路径、PE阵列划分和数据流。

papers.abstract: Today's dominant route to generalist robots scales robotics data to train end-to-end policies. We instead use a vision-language model (VLM) as a coding agent that writes robot programs using a curated library of perception, planning, and control tools. MAESTRO's orchestration harness packages multi-step perception and action procedures into callable tools and guides their use through a plan-act-replan loop, using visual and execution feedback to verify outcomes and recover from failures. With this tool library and harness, MAESTRO matches or surpasses state-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models zero-shot in our tabletop comparison and performs diverse mobile manipulation tasks, without collecting new teleoperation data or invoking a VLA tool. Ablations show that expanding the tool library improves average task progress with the full harness, while adding tools without it does not reliably improve progress. Case studies illustrate MAESTRO's potential for autonomous code improvement across trials, faster execution with VLA tools, and automatic robot data generation. We show that expanding robotics tool libraries together with their orchestration harnesses offers a complementary route to general-purpose robots alongside scaling end-to-end robot training data. Project site: https://maestro-robot.github.io. Code: https://github.com/penn-pal-lab/maestro.

analysis.key_results: 在桌面比较中，MAESTRO在零样本条件下达到或超越最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型，并能执行多样的移动操作任务；消融实验表明扩展工具库在完整编排框架下能提升任务进度，而仅增加工具而没有完整框架则不能可靠地提升性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MAESTRO框架，利用视觉语言模型作为编码智能体，通过工具库与plan-act-replan闭环实现零样本通用机器人操作，并证明其能达到或超越最新VLA模型的性能。
analysis.method: 使用视觉语言模型作为编码智能体，将多步感知与动作过程封装为可调用工具，并通过plan-act-replan循环利用视觉和执行反馈进行验证与错误恢复；在桌面操作与移动操作任务上进行零样本评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MAESTRO提出将视觉语言模型作为编码智能体，通过编排感知、规划与控制工具库实现零样本通用机器人操作，而非依赖端到端策略训练。

papers.abstract: Multimodal agents built on large vision-language models are increasingly deployed in open-world settings but remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection. Typographic text-in-image attacks such as FigStep have been evaluated mainly on standalone vision-language models. For agents, user goals, webpage context, and action history make the effect of embedded instructions uncertain, and robustness to behavior-guided, adaptive visual injections remains insufficiently studied. We introduce AgentTypo, a black-box red-teaming framework that launches adaptive typographic prompt injection by embedding optimized text into webpage images. We formulate an attention-guided automatic typographic prompt-injection objective that favors the attacker's expected answer over the clean-page answer, together with task-conditioned visual attention from small question-answering models. A novel black-box optimization method searches text position, contrast, and color. To further strengthen the attack, we develop a multi-LLM system that iteratively refines injection prompts using evaluation feedback and retrieves successful past examples for strategy learning. Experiments on the VWA-Adv and Mind2Web benchmarks show that AgentTypo significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based prompt injection attacks. Across seven closed- and open-source model backends, AgentTypo-pro achieves 45%-83% ASR, outperforming the CLIP-based AgentAttack by 29-47% and previous typographic attacks by 25%-37% on VWA-Adv.

analysis.key_results: 在VWA-Adv和Mind2Web基准上，AgentTypo显著优于现有图像提示注入攻击；在VWA-Adv上，AgentTypo-pro在七个闭源和开源模型后端上达到45%-83%的ASR，超过CLIP-based AgentAttack 29-47%，超过先前排版攻击25%-37%。

analysis.method: 利用注意力引导的自动排版提示注入目标，结合小型问答模型的任务条件视觉注意力，通过黑盒优化搜索文本位置、对比度和颜色，并使用多LLM系统迭代优化注入提示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AgentTypo框架，通过自适应排版文本注入攻击多模态智能体，在黑盒设置下显著提高攻击成功率。

papers.abstract: Post-training LLM compression often relies on low-rank approximations, which force all columns of a projection matrix to share a single low-dimensional subspace. We propose CoSpaDi, a training-free compression framework that replaces this single-subspace assumption with a union-of-subspaces model via sparse dictionary learning. CoSpaDi factorizes each weight matrix into a dense dictionary and column-sparse coefficients, allowing different columns to select different subsets of dictionary atoms at the same storage budget. To preserve model behavior, we use calibration activations to transform functional reconstruction into a standard dictionary learning problem. Across LLaMA and Qwen models, CoSpaDi improves accuracy-compression and perplexity-compression trade-offs over SVD-based and structured pruning baselines at 20-40\% compression ratios, while naturally supporting sparse-dense computation and post-training quantization of sparse coefficients.

analysis.key_results: 在LLaMA和Qwen模型上，CoSpaDi在20-40%压缩比下，相比SVD和结构化剪枝基线提升了精度-压缩和困惑度-压缩的权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoSpaDi，一种训练-free的LLM压缩框架，将权重矩阵分解为稠密字典和列稀疏系数，用联合子空间模型替代低秩近似的单一共享子空间假设。
analysis.method: 使用校准激活将功能重建转化为标准字典学习问题，对每个权重矩阵分解为稠密字典和列稀疏系数，不同列可选择不同字典原子子集，并支持稀疏-稠密计算和系数量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练-free的LLM压缩框架CoSpaDi，用稀疏字典学习替代低秩共享子空间假设，以提升压缩效率并支持量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM的效率优化，不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型或世界模型（WAM），但其稀疏字典学习和训练-free压缩方法可作为通用高效推理技术，潜在可移植到机器人策略网络等具身模型。

papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an indispensable part of natural language processing tasks. However, autoregressive sampling has become an efficiency bottleneck. Multi-Draft Speculative Decoding (MDSD) is a recent approach where, when generating each token, a small draft model generates multiple drafts, and the target LLM verifies them in parallel, ensuring that the final output conforms to the target model distribution. The two main design choices in MDSD are the draft sampling method and the verification algorithm. For a fixed draft sampling method, the optimal acceptance rate is a solution to an optimal transport problem, but the complexity of this problem makes it difficult to solve for the optimal acceptance rate and measure the gap between existing verification algorithms and the theoretical upper bound. This paper discusses the dual of the optimal transport problem, providing a way to efficiently compute the optimal acceptance rate. For the first time, we measure the theoretical upper bound of MDSD efficiency for vocabulary sizes in the thousands and quantify the gap between existing verification algorithms and this bound. We also compare different draft sampling methods based on their optimal acceptance rates. Our results show that the draft sampling method strongly influences the optimal acceptance rate, with sampling without replacement outperforming sampling with replacement. Additionally, existing verification algorithms do not reach the theoretical upper bound for both without replacement and with replacement sampling. Our findings suggest that carefully designed draft sampling methods can potentially improve the optimal acceptance rate and enable the development of verification algorithms that closely match the theoretical upper bound.

analysis.key_results: 无放回采样优于有放回采样；现有验证算法在两种采样方式下均未达到理论上界。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出利用最优传输问题的对偶高效计算多草案推测解码的理论最优接受率，首次在数千词汇规模下量化现有验证算法与理论上界的差距。
analysis.method: 将多草案推测解码的接受率视为最优传输问题，通过求解其对偶问题来计算最优接受率，并比较不同草案采样方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过求解最优传输问题的对偶，首次高效计算多草案推测解码的理论最优接受率，并量化现有验证算法与理论上限的差距。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于独立于机器人的推测解码效率问题，未涉及 VLA/WAM 或机器人世界模型，但对提升大语言模型和潜在多模态模型的推理效率具有基础性价值。
